exact_operator_go_present.description: Must be true. Operator must exactly state their approval.

process_env_variables_present.description: Must be true. Required TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TEST_TELEGRAM_CHANNEL must exist in env.

untracked_env_file_present.description: Can be true or false. Indicates if an untracked .env file exists locally without reading it.

wrapper_script_requested.description: Must be false. Using ad-hoc wrapper scripts is strictly forbidden.

live_attempt_count.description: Must be exactly 0. Retries require explicit reset and new operator approval.
